Title: [Reprice][Response] Verify Reprice of a selected offer returns the full price breakdown and penalty text.
Capabilities / Test Data: Reshop offerId from a date-change Reshop.
Preconditions: Ticketed Booked PNR on OmanAirV17/EGY on stg-ne-2 (Re-Issue collection environment; confirm before the run), created via V2 Family A (Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book -> Retrieve): 1 ADT, one-way MCT-DXB, Economy, departure D+21. Retrieve shows tickets[] populated (one per passenger), booking unflown. pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken and ticket numbers recorded. TC-RI-CAP-01..03 passed.
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. Eligibility -> Reshop (date change). 2. POST Reprice with supplier, credentialsSelector, responseId and selectedOfferId = offers[0].offerId from Reshop. 3. Record selectedOffer.priceDetails and every penalty/fee field.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 with a new responseId and selectedOffer (offerId, priceDetails with total and its breakdown). The exchange penalty is present in the rulesAndPenalties text format (Q15) in the Reshop offer or the Reprice response: record which. The change fee is visible in the breakdown (Q16).
SpecReference: AC-05; AC-06; AC-09; AN#14, #17, #21; Q15, Q16; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue/Reprice; SPEC §2.16
Notes: Type: Functional | Technique: EP | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection. Field names TBD; assert presence and meaning, not exact keys, until the contract is shared.
